race.comment: ALL KINDS OF FOLK (9) was no match for the impressive Brindavan last time but still did a great job to fend off the rest. Peaking now and reunites with Thompson. Will take some stitching. ATMOSPHERE (1) was well backed late last start and lived right up to expectation, proving too quick for LAST COMMAND and PERFECT PLAY. Carries more weight this time but has enough pace too offset the draw and should give backers another bold sight. CHIEF IN CHARGE (12) has built nicely into this prep and rates a lightweight flyer. Is a course specialist who could cause quite the headache. PERFECT PLAY (4) kept on gamely into fourth in tough going last time and her form prior is right up to scratch. Is drawn to get all the favours and deserves consideration.
